item.title: 【BLU-RAY】BLU-RAY - Deep Purple with Orchestra - Live in Verona (2014) Blu-ray
item.description:
Deep Purple with Orchestra - Live in Verona (2014) Blu-ray



Filmed in the spectacular setting of the Arena of Verona, a Roman amphitheater built in 30 AD, this summer 2011 concert features Deep Purple along with a complete symphony orchestra and many classics such as "Smoke On The Water," "Lazy", "Strange Kind Of Woman," "Perfect Strangers," "Highway or "Woman From Tokyo Undoubtedly, Deep Purple continues to be among the best rock bands on our planet and are unbeatable especially on stage. The orchestral arrangements give the well-known songs additional depth and expressiveness, and Deep Purple can be carried away by the orchestra and the enthusiastic audience at this legendary venue to a brilliant show. The bonus material includes two more Purple classics with "Hush" and "Black Night".
